thread:
Marisol: Quick check — finalizing two sends this week: the benchmark digest and the webinar invite. Need subject + preheader signoff and confirmation of segmentation + send windows. Current plan: benchmark digest -> Tue 9:00am PDT; webinar invite -> Wed 10:00am PDT to engaged cohort. Any objections?
Ana: Looks good. Do we have subject options for the benchmark?
Marisol: Yes, short list:
1) New latency & cost benchmarks — 50% lower token cost for common RLHF flows
2) Benchmarks: same output quality, half the token spend
3) How we cut inference cost without trading latency
Which reads best for devs?
Sam: I like 1 but shorten to: "New benchmarks — 50% lower token cost" (keeps the hook) :thumbsup:
Mike: Heads up on copy: call out "developer-first" credibility somewhere in the first two lines and add a direct CTA to book a demo or try the hosted API. Also add a two-line TL;DR at the top for busy readers.
Marisol: Got it — TL;DR + CTA. For preheaders: option A: "See latency & cost numbers from production workloads"; option B: "Benchmarks, topology tips, and cost-saving wins". Prefer A.
Devin: Segment logic for webinar invite (engaged cohort): users with any email open in last 60 days OR API activity in last 30 days, minus anyone who registered for the webinar or unsubscribed. Rough SQL below:
```sql
SELECT user_id
FROM users u
WHERE (u.last_email_open >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days')
  OR (u.last_api_call >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days')
AND u.unsubscribe = false
AND u.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM webinar_registrations WHERE webinar_id = 2025)
```
Marisol: Perfect. For cadence, we should exclude customers on Dedicated migration trial (they get a separate outreach). Devin — can you flag that in the segment?
Devin: Yep will add a clause to exclude `trial_tag = 'dedicated-migration'` before we run.
Ana: Quick A/B test ideas for subject on the webinar invite? We could test urgency vs value: A) "Live: Interpreting inference benchmarks for real apps" B) "Join us — how teams cut inference cost 2x"
Sam: Run the value headline (B) as the primary, urgency as variant. Send variant to 10% of the segment for opens + CTR.
Marisol: OK — timeline: final copy today EOD, creatives (hero + 2 screenshots) by EOD tomorrow, schedule sends Tue/Wed. Can people reply with :thumbsup: to approve? Otherwise I'll assume this plan moves forward.
Mike: :thumbsup: from Content. Small ask — include one customer quote in the digest if we have permission.
Marisol: We have permission from Acme — will insert.
LaunchBot: Scheduled draft created: campaign id 20250312-bench-digest (will queue when final approved).
Ana: :thumbsup: approved.
Devin: Segment built and flagged for review, will send sample CSV for a quick spot-check in #marketing-review in 30m.
Marisol: Thanks everyone — if no more comments I'll post final copy here by 5pm PST and trigger the schedule.
